question_bank.stem: A company wants to transform a business process with AI. What response best diagnoses the mindset Laurence says is valuable in interviews and production work?

options.label: A
options.text: Frame the change around production value, business impact, and risk mitigation.

options.label: B
options.text: Frame the change around model novelty, demo quality, and launch excitement.

options.label: C
options.text: Frame the change around social visibility, public slogans, and broad ambition.

options.label: D
options.text: Frame the change around benchmark scores, tool choice, and hiring volume.

question_bank.correct_answer: Frame the change around production value, business impact, and risk mitigation.
question_bank.explanation: The lecture emphasizes production, business focus, and risk mitigation as the mindset that opens doors in current AI work.
